content: Go stdlib does NOT include a TOML parser as of Go 1.26. pelletier/go-toml v2 (TOML v1.1.0, v2.4.0 released 2026-06) is the de-facto ecosystem standard with API modeled on encoding/json. golang/go issues #60791 and #68361 (generic encoding struct tag) were closed/merged and were never about adding a TOML package. Verified by absence: no golang.org source mentions encoding/toml. Implication for stdlib-only project_probe: pyproject.toml and Cargo.toml require a hand-rolled minimal TOML subset parser (scalar key=value under [project], [tool.poetry], [package] tables) or dropping the stdlib-only constraint for a dependency.
